# min.features = 200: keep cells with at least 200 detected genes

pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Keep cells with 200-2500 features and <5% mitochondrial content

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
# vst method: variance stabilizing transformation
# Select top 2000 highly variable genes
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data
sc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
sc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sc.data, project = "pbmc3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add mitochondrial percentage
sc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells
sc <- subset(sc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
sc <- NormalizeData(sc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
sc <- FindVariableFeatures(sc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
sc <- ScaleData(sc, features = rownames(sc))

# Run PCA
sc <- RunPCA(sc, features = VariableFeatures(object = sc))

# Clustering
sc <- FindNeighbors(sc, dims = 1:10)
sc <- FindClusters(sc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
sc <- RunUMAP(sc, dims = 1:10)

# DoubletFinder - pK identification
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Homotypic doublet proportion
annotations <- sc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)

# Expected number of doublets (assuming 7.5% doublet rate)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * nrow(sc@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
sc <- doubletFinder_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get the classification column name
classification_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(sc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets and singlets on UMAP
p1 <- DimPlot(sc, reduction = "umap", group.by = classification_col, cols = c("red", "gray"))
print(p1)

# Filter to keep only singlets
sc_singlet <- subset(sc, subset = !!sym(classification_col) == "Singlet")

# Visualize singlets only
p2 <- DimPlot(sc_singlet, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters")
print(p2)

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

# Load the PBMC dataset from the current working directory
# Read10X expects a directory containing barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv, and matrix.mtx
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object with initial filtering
# min.cells = 3: include features detected in at least 3 cells
# min.features = 200: include cells with at least 200 detected features
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
# Pattern "^MT-" matches mitochondrial genes (human nomenclature)
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
# nFeature_RNA > 200: minimum gene count
# nFeature_RNA < 2500: maximum gene count (removes potential doublets)
# percent.mt < 5: maximum mitochondrial percentage (removes dying cells)
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
# LogNormalize: log(count/total_counts * scale.factor + 1)
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Identify highly variable features
# vst method: variance stabilizing transformation
# nfeatures = 2000: select top 2000 variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
# Centers and scales variable features
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# Run PCA
# Uses variable features for dimensionality reduction
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# Construct KNN graph and find clusters
# dims = 1:10: use first 10 principal components
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Find clusters using Louvain algorithm
# resolution = 0.5: controls granularity of clustering
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP for visualization
# dims = 1:10: use same PC dimensions as clustering
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Save final Seurat object to disk
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_final.rds")

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)

# Load 10X data from current directory
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# Run PCA and UMAP (required for DoubletFinder)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Find clusters for homotypic doublet estimation
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Optimize pK parameter using paramSweep
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:20, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Plot pK optimization
ggplot(bcmvn, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()

# Select optimal pK (highest BCmetric)
optimal_pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected number of doublets (assuming ~7% doublet rate for 10X)
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.07 * ncol(pbmc))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = optimal_pK, 
                         nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get the classification column name (it's dynamically generated)
df_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets on UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = df_col)

# Print doublet statistics
table(pbmc@meta.data[[df_col]])

# Subset to keep only singlets
pbmc_singlets <- subset(pbmc, subset = !!sym(df_col) == "Singlet")

# Visualize singlets only
DimPlot(pbmc_singlets, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters")

# Print final cell count
cat("Original cells:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Singlets retained:", ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed:", ncol(pbmc) - ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")

library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)

# Load the PBMC dataset
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc_analysis", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC visualization
pdf("qc_plots.pdf", width = 12, height = 4)
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
dev.off()

pdf("qc_scatter_plots.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
print(plot1 + plot2)
dev.off()

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify top 10 variable features
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)

# Plot variable features
pdf("variable_features.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(plot2)
dev.off()

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Visualize PCA
pdf("pca_plots.pdf", width = 12, height = 5)
print(VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca"))
print(DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca"))
print(DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE))
dev.off()

# Elbow plot
pdf("elbow_plot.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
ElbowPlot(pbmc)
dev.off()

# Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Visualize UMAP
pdf("umap_plot.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
dev.off()

# Find all markers
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Get top markers per cluster
top_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)

# Save marker genes
write.csv(pbmc.markers, "all_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_markers, "top10_markers_per_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Visualize top markers
pdf("marker_feature_plots.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)
top_genes <- top_markers %>% slice_head(n = 9) %>% pull(gene)
FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = top_genes)
dev.off()

pdf("marker_violin_plots.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = top_genes)
dev.off()

# Heatmap of top markers
top10_all <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)

pdf("marker_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top10_all$gene) + NoLegend()
dev.off()

# Save Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_seurat_object.rds")

print("Analysis complete. All outputs saved.")

# Load required libraries

library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Set working directory (adjust to your file location)
# setwd("path/to/your/data")

# ============================================
# 1. Load the data files
# ============================================

# Read the sparse matrix (Matrix Market format)
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell identifiers)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes (gene identifiers and symbols)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_symbol")

# ============================================
# 2. Assign row and column names to matrix
# ============================================

# Set gene symbols as row names and barcodes as column names
rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

# ============================================
# 3. Create Seurat object
# ============================================

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = matrix,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,      # Include genes detected in at least 3 cells
  min.features = 200  # Include cells with at least 200 detected genes
)

# ============================================
# 4. Calculate mitochondrial gene percentage
# ============================================

# Identify mitochondrial genes (genes starting with "MT-")
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Alternative manual calculation if needed:
# mito_genes <- grep("^MT-", rownames(pbmc), value = TRUE)
# pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- colSums(pbmc@assays$RNA@counts[mito_genes, ]) / 
#                          colSums(pbmc@assays$RNA@counts) * 100

# ============================================
# 5. View QC metrics summary
# ============================================

# Display summary statistics
cat("\n=== QC Metrics Summary ===\n")
summary(pbmc$nFeature_RNA)
summary(pbmc$nCount_RNA)
summary(pbmc$percent.mt)

# View first few cells
head(pbmc@meta.data)

# ============================================
# 6. Create violin plots for QC metrics
# ============================================

# Violin plot using Seurat's built-in function
p1 <- VlnPlot(
  pbmc, 
  features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0.1  # Point size for individual cells
)

# Display the plot
print(p1)

# Save the plot
ggsave("QC_violin_plots.png", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)

# ============================================
# 7. Alternative: Custom ggplot2 violin plots
# ============================================

# Extract metadata for custom plotting
metadata <- pbmc@meta.data

# Create individual plots with more customization
p2 <- ggplot(metadata, aes(x = "", y = nFeature_RNA)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "lightblue", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Number of Genes per Cell", 
       x = "", 
       y = "nFeature_RNA") +
  theme_classic()

p3 <- ggplot(metadata, aes(x = "", y = nCount_RNA)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "lightgreen", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "UMI Counts per Cell", 
       x = "", 
       y = "nCount_RNA") +
  theme_classic()

p4 <- ggplot(metadata, aes(x = "", y = percent.mt)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "salmon", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Mitochondrial Gene %", 
       x = "", 
       y = "percent.mt") +
  theme_classic()

# Combine plots using patchwork or cowplot
library(patchwork)
combined_plot <- p2 | p3 | p4
print(combined_plot)

ggsave("QC_violin_plots_custom.png", plot = combined_plot, 
       width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)

# ============================================
# 8. Additional QC visualizations
# ============================================

# Scatter plots to identify outliers
p5 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
p6 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

print(p5)

  counts = matrix,
  project = "PBMC_2700",
  min.cells = 3,

  pbmc,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000
)

print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)

VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")

# PCA plot colored by total UMI counts
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# ============================================================

# Calculate percentage of variance explained
pct <- pca_stdev / sum(pca_stdev) * 100

# Calculate cumulative variance
cumulative <- cumsum(pct)

# Find PC where cumulative variance reaches 90%
pc_90 <- which(cumulative > 90)[1]

# Find PC where change in variance is less than 0.1%
co1 <- which(diff(pct) < 0.1)[1]

# Find PC where cumulative change is less than 0.1%
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = TRUE)[1] + 1

# Minimum of the three methods
pcs_to_use <- min(pc_90, co1, co2)

cat("\nSuggested number of PCs to use:", pcs_to_use, "\n")
cat("PC at 90% variance:", pc_90, "\n")
cat("PC where variance change < 0.1%:", co1, "\n")

# ============================================================
# STEP 11: Save the Seurat object
# ============================================================

saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_2700_processed.rds")

rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

# ============================================================================
# 2. CREATE SEURAT OBJECT
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating Seurat object...\n")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = matrix,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,      # Keep genes expressed in at least 3 cells
  min.features = 200  # Keep cells with at least 200 detected genes
)

cat(sprintf("Seurat object created: %d genes x %d cells\n", 
            nrow(pbmc), ncol(pbmc)))

# ============================================================================
# 3. QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================================

cat("\nPerforming quality control...\n")

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics before filtering
cat("\nQC Metrics Summary (before filtering):\n")
print(summary(pbmc$nFeature_RNA))
print(summary(pbmc$nCount_RNA))
print(summary(pbmc$percent.mt))

# Create QC plots
p1 <- VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), 
              ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)
ggsave("qc_violin_before_filtering.pdf", p1, width = 12, height = 4)

p2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2500, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 200, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
ggsave("qc_scatter_before_filtering.pdf", p2, width = 6, height = 5)

# ============================================================================
# 4. FILTER LOW-QUALITY CELLS
# ============================================================================

cat("\nFiltering low-quality cells...\n")

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = 
                 nFeature_RNA > 200 &      # Minimum genes per cell
                 nFeature_RNA < 2500 &     # Maximum genes per cell (doublet filter)
                 percent.mt < 5)           # Maximum mitochondrial percentage

            nrow(pbmc), ncol(pbmc)))

# ============================================================================

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, 
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                      scale.factor = 10000)

# ============================================================================

cat("\nIdentifying highly variable features...\n")

# Find highly variable genes
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, 
                             selection.method = "vst",
                             nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

p3 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
p3 <- LabelPoints(plot = p3, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
ggsave("variable_features.pdf", p3, width = 8, height = 6)

# 8. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION - PCA
# ============================================================================

               features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc),
               npcs = 50,

ggsave("pca_plot.pdf", p4, width = 7, height = 6)

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================

dims_to_use <- 1:30
cat(sprintf("\nUsing %d principal components for clustering\n", length(dims_to_use)))

# ============================================================================
# 10. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

cat("\nPerforming clustering...\n")

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = dims_to_use)

# Find clusters (Louvain algorithm)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

# Print cluster sizes
cat("\nCluster sizes:\n")
print(table(Idents(pbmc)))

# ============================================================================
# 11. UMAP VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\nComputing UMAP...\n")

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = dims_to_use, verbose = FALSE)

# Visualize UMAP
p6 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 6) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters (UMAP)")
ggsave("umap_clusters.pdf", p6, width = 8, height = 7)

# UMAP colored by QC metrics
p7 <- FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),

# Check marker specificity
# Calculate percentage of cells expressing each marker in each cluster
marker_expression <- function(seurat_obj, markers) {
  results <- data.frame()
  for (marker in markers) {
    pct <- sapply(levels(Idents(seurat_obj)), function(cluster) {
      cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, idents = cluster)
      sum(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")[marker, cells] > 0) / length(cells) * 100
    })
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Gene = marker, Cluster = names(pct), Percentage = pct))
  }
  return(results)
}

)

# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage

        ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)

library(Seurat)

# ============================================
# 1. Load 10x Genomics Data
# ============================================
# Assuming your files are in a directory called "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "path/to/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, 
                           project = "PBMC", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

# ============================================
# 2. Quality Control and Filtering
# ============================================
# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                              nFeature_RNA < 6000 & 
                              percent.mt < 15)

# ============================================
# 3. Standard Pre-processing
# ============================================
# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# ============================================
# 4. Clustering for DoubletFinder
# ============================================
# Use appropriate number of PCs (adjust based on ElbowPlot)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)

# ============================================
# 5. DoubletFinder - Parameter Optimization
# ============================================
# pK Identification (no ground-truth)
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_optimal <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
cat("Optimal pK:", pK_optimal, "\n")

# ============================================
# 6. Estimate Doublet Rate
# ============================================
# Homotypic doublet proportion estimate
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)

# Expected doublet rate (adjust based on cell recovery)
# Rule of thumb: ~0.8% per 1000 cells recovered
nCells <- ncol(pbmc)
expected_doublet_rate <- 0.008 * (nCells / 1000)  # Adjust as needed
cat("Expected doublet rate:", expected_doublet_rate, "\n")

# Adjust for homotypic doublets
nExp_poi <- round(expected_doublet_rate * nCells)
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

cat("Expected doublets:", nExp_poi, "\n")
cat("Adjusted expected doublets:", nExp_poi.adj, "\n")

# ============================================
# 7. Run DoubletFinder
# ============================================
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, 
                         PCs = 1:30, 
                         pN = 0.25,  # proportion of artificial doublets
                         pK = pK_optimal, 
                         nExp = nExp_poi.adj,
                         reuse.pANN = FALSE,
                         sct = FALSE)

# Get the DoubletFinder column name (it's auto-generated)
df_column <- colnames(pbmc@meta.data)[grep("DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data))]

# ============================================
# 8. Visualize Doublets
# ============================================
# UMAP with doublet labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = df_column, 
        cols = c("Singlet" = "blue", "Doublet" = "red")) +
  ggtitle("Doublet Detection Results")

# Count doublets
table(pbmc@meta.data[[df_column]])

# Doublets by cluster
doublet_summary <- pbmc@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters, .data[[df_column]]) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = df_column, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

print(doublet_summary)

# ============================================
# 9. Remove Doublets
# ============================================
# Filter out doublets
pbmc_singlets <- subset(pbmc, subset = .data[[df_column]] == "Singlet")

cat("\nOriginal cells:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Singlets retained:", ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed:", ncol(pbmc) - ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")

# ============================================
# 10. Re-process Singlets for Downstream Analysis
# ============================================
# Re-normalize and re-cluster with singlets only
pbmc_singlets <- NormalizeData(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc_singlets, nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc_singlets <- ScaleData(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- RunPCA(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- FindNeighbors(pbmc_singlets, dims = 1:30)
pbmc_singlets <- FindClusters(pbmc_singlets, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc_singlets <- RunUMAP(pbmc_singlets, dims = 1:30)

# Visualize cleaned data
DimPlot(pbmc_singlets, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Data After Doublet Removal")

# ============================================
# 11. Save Results
# ============================================
# Save cleaned Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc_singlets, file = "pbmc_singlets_cleaned.rds")

# Export doublet information
write.csv(pbmc@meta.data, file = "doublet_detection_results.csv")

cat("\nDoublet detection and removal complete!\n")

# Production-ready script with comprehensive QC, analysis, and output generation

```r
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# =============================================================================
# PBMC Single-Cell RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline using Seurat
# =============================================================================
# Description: Complete workflow from raw counts to cell type annotation
# Author: BioAssistant (ROLV)
# Date: 2024
# =============================================================================

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(Matrix)
  library(future)
})

# Set up parallel processing
plan("multisession", workers = 4)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)  # 8GB

# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

# Input/Output paths
INPUT_DIR <- "data/raw_counts"  # Directory with matrix.mtx, genes.tsv, barcodes.tsv
OUTPUT_DIR <- "results/seurat_analysis"
FIGURES_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures")
DATA_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "data")

# Create output directories
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(DATA_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# QC thresholds
MIN_FEATURES <- 200      # Minimum genes per cell
MAX_FEATURES <- 5000     # Maximum genes per cell
MAX_MT_PERCENT <- 15     # Maximum mitochondrial percentage

# Analysis parameters
N_VARIABLE_FEATURES <- 2000
N_PCS <- 30
RESOLUTION <- 0.5

# =============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# =============================================================================

save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 10, height = 8) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(FIGURES_DIR, filename),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
  message(sprintf("Saved: %s", filename))
}

log_step <- function(message) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] %s\n", Sys.time(), message))
}

# =============================================================================
# 1. DATA LOADING
# =============================================================================

log_step("Loading raw count data...")

# Load 10X data (adjust based on your input format)
# Option 1: 10X format (matrix.mtx, genes.tsv, barcodes.tsv)
if (file.exists(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "matrix.mtx.gz")) || 
    file.exists(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "matrix.mtx"))) {
  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = INPUT_DIR)
} else if (file.exists(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "counts.rds"))) {
  # Option 2: R object
  counts <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "counts.rds"))
} else {
  stop("No valid input data found. Please check INPUT_DIR.")
}

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  project = "PBMC_scRNA",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = MIN_FEATURES
)

log_step(sprintf("Loaded %d cells and %d genes", ncol(pbmc), nrow(pbmc)))

# =============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL
# =============================================================================

log_step("Performing quality control...")

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Calculate ribosomal percentage
pbmc[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^RP[SL]")

# QC metrics before filtering
qc_before <- data.frame(
  nCount_RNA = pbmc$nCount_RNA,
  nFeature_RNA = pbmc$nFeature_RNA,
  percent.mt = pbmc$percent.mt,
  status = "Before"
)

# Visualize QC metrics
p1 <- VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), 
              ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)
save_plot(p1, "01_qc_violin_before_filtering.png", width = 15, height = 6)

p2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = MAX_MT_PERCENT, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
p3 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(MIN_FEATURES, MAX_FEATURES), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
save_plot(p2 + p3, "02_qc_scatter_before_filtering.png", width = 14, height = 6)

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(
  pbmc,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > MIN_FEATURES & 
           nFeature_RNA < MAX_FEATURES & 
           percent.mt < MAX_MT_PERCENT
)

log_step(sprintf("After filtering: %d cells retained", ncol(pbmc)))

# QC metrics after filtering
qc_after <- data.frame(
  nCount_RNA = pbmc$nCount_RNA,
  nFeature_RNA = pbmc$nFeature_RNA,
  percent.mt = pbmc$percent.mt,
  status = "After"
)

# Save QC summary
qc_summary <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    Metric = c("Total Cells", "Median Genes", "Median UMIs", "Median MT%"),
    Before = c(
      nrow(qc_before),
      median(qc_before$nFeature_RNA),
      median(qc_before$nCount_RNA),
      round(median(qc_before$percent.mt), 2)
    ),
    After = c(
      nrow(qc_after),
      median(qc_after$nFeature_RNA),
      median(qc_after$nCount_RNA),
      round(median(qc_after$percent.mt), 2)
    )
  )
)
write.csv(qc_summary, file.path(DATA_DIR, "qc_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

log_step("Normalizing data...")

pbmc <- NormalizeData(
  pbmc,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000
)

# =============================================================================
# 4. FEATURE SELECTION
# =============================================================================

log_step("Identifying highly variable features...")

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(
  pbmc,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = N_VARIABLE_FEATURES
)

# Plot variable features
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
p4 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
p5 <- LabelPoints(plot = p4, points = top10, repel = TRUE, xnudge = 0, ynudge = 0)
save_plot(p5, "03_variable_features.png", width = 12, height = 8)

# =============================================================================
# 5. SCALING AND PCA
# =============================================================================

log_step("Scaling data and running PCA...")

# Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(
  pbmc,
  features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc),
  npcs = N_PCS,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# Visualize PCA
p6 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca") + ggtitle("PCA")
save_plot(p6, "04_pca_plot.png")

p7 <- ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = N_PCS)
save_plot(p7, "05_elbow_plot.png")

# PCA heatmaps
pdf(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "06_pca_heatmaps.pdf"), width = 12, height = 20)
DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE, ncol = 3)
dev.off()

# =============================================================================
# 6. CLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

log_step("Performing clustering...")

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Find clusters
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = RESOLUTION)

log_step(sprintf("Identified %d clusters", length(unique(pbmc$seurat_clusters))))

# =============================================================================
# 7. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION (UMAP & tSNE)
# =============================================================================

log_step("Running UMAP and tSNE...")

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- RunTSNE(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Visualize clusters
p8 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("UMAP - Clusters")
p9 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("tSNE - Clusters")
save_plot(p8 + p9, "07_umap_tsne_clusters.png", width = 16, height = 7)

# =============================================================================
# 8. FIND CLUSTER MARKERS
# =============================================================================

log_step("Finding cluster markers...")

# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  pbmc,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

# Save all markers
write.csv(
  pbmc.markers,
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "all_cluster_markers.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Top markers per cluster
top_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

write.csv(
  top_markers,
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "top10_markers_per_cluster.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Heatmap of top markers
top5 <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

p10 <- DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top5$gene) + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
save_plot(p10, "08_top_markers_heatmap.png", width = 14, height = 12)

# =============================================================================
# 9. CELL TYPE ANNOTATION
# =============================================================================

log_step("Annotating cell types...")

# PBMC canonical markers
canonical_markers <- list(

dir.create(DATA_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MAX_MT_PERCENT <- 15     # Maximum mitochondrial percentage

N_PCS <- 30
RESOLUTION <- 0.5

# =============================================================================
# LOGGING FUNCTION
# =============================================================================

log_message <- function(message) {
  timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  cat(sprintf("[%s] %s\n", timestamp, message))
}

# 1. DATA LOADING
# =============================================================================

log_message("Starting PBMC scRNA-seq analysis pipeline")
log_message("Loading raw count data...")

# Load 10X data (adjust based on your input format)
# Option 1: 10X format (matrix.mtx, genes.tsv, barcodes.tsv)
if (file.exists(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "matrix.mtx.gz")) || 
    file.exists(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "matrix.mtx"))) {
  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = INPUT_DIR)
} else if (file.exists(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "counts.rds"))) {
  # Option 2: RDS file
  counts <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "counts.rds"))
} else {
  stop("No valid input data found. Please provide matrix.mtx or counts.rds")
}

log_message(sprintf("Loaded data: %d genes x %d cells", 
                   nrow(counts), ncol(counts)))

)

# Calculate ribosomal percentage

  nCells = ncol(pbmc),
  median_nFeature = median(pbmc$nFeature_RNA),
  median_nCount = median(pbmc$nCount_RNA),
  median_percent_mt = median(pbmc$percent.mt)
)

              ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)

       p1, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)

p2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = MAX_MT_PERCENT, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
p3 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(MIN_FEATURES, MAX_FEATURES), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
p_scatter <- p2 | p3
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "02_QC_scatter_before_filtering.png"), 
       p_scatter, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Apply QC filters
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = 
                 nFeature_RNA > MIN_FEATURES & 
                 nFeature_RNA < MAX_FEATURES & 
                 percent.mt < MAX_MT_PERCENT)

log_message(sprintf("After QC filtering: %d cells retained", ncol(pbmc)))

# QC metrics after filtering
qc_after <- data.frame(
  nCells = ncol(pbmc),
  median_nFeature = median(pbmc$nFeature_RNA),
  median_nCount = median(pbmc$nCount_RNA),
  median_percent_mt = median(pbmc$percent.mt)
)

)
write.csv(qc_summary, file.path(DATA_DIR, "QC_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# 4. NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
                     scale.factor = 10000)

# 5. FEATURE SELECTION
# =============================================================================

log_message("Identifying highly variable features...")

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", 
                             nfeatures = N_VARIABLE_FEATURES)

# Plot variable features
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
p4 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
p5 <- LabelPoints(plot = p4, points = top10, repel = TRUE, xnudge = 0, ynudge = 0)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "03_variable_features.png"),

# Save variable features
write.csv(data.frame(Gene = VariableFeatures(pbmc)), 
          file.path(DATA_DIR, "variable_features.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

log_message("Performing clustering...")

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = RESOLUTION)

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Read data
counts <- readMM("matrix.mtx")
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Assign row and column names
colnames(counts) <- barcodes$V1
rownames(counts) <- genes$V1  # gene IDs
# Add gene symbols as metadata
gene_symbols <- genes$V2
rownames(counts) <- paste0(rownames(counts), "_", gene_symbols)

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC")

# Seurat preprocessing pipeline
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# DoubletFinder
# Estimate pK
pK <- find.pK(pbmc, PCs = 1:20)
pK_opt <- pK$pK[which.max(pK$BCmetric)]

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_opt, nExp = round(0.075 * ncol(pbmc)), reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Visualize UMAP with singlet/doublet classification
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "DF.classifications_0.25_0.075_0.25") + 
  ggtitle("UMAP: Singlets vs Doublets")

barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$V1
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(mat) <- genes$V2   # use HGNC symbols
colnames(mat) <- barcodes

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# QC: calculate percent mitochondrial genes
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalization and variable features
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scaling and PCA
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Identify markers for each cluster
markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Assign cell type labels based on known markers
cluster_ids <- c(
  "CD4 T cells" = which(markers$gene %in% c("IL7R", "CCR7") & markers$p_val_adj < 0.05)[1],
  "CD14 Monocytes" = which(markers$gene %in% c("CD14", "LYZ") & markers$p_val_adj < 0.05)[1],
  "B cells" = which(markers$gene %in% c("MS4A1") & markers$p_val_adj < 0.05)[1],
  "CD8 T cells" = which(markers$gene %in% c("CD8A") & markers$p_val_adj < 0.05)[1],
  "NK cells" = which(markers$gene %in% c("GNLY", "NKG7") & markers$p_val_adj < 0.05)[1]
)

# Map cluster numbers to labels
cluster_levels <- levels(pbmc)
cluster_labels <- setNames(names(cluster_ids), cluster_ids)
pbmc <- RenameIdents(pbmc, cluster_labels)

# Plot annotated UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Annotated PBMC UMAP")

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)

# Load data
matrix_file <- "matrix.mtx"
barcodes_file <- "barcodes.tsv"
genes_file <- "genes.tsv"

counts <- readMM(matrix_file)
barcodes <- read.table(barcodes_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$V1
genes <- read.table(genes_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(counts) <- genes$V2  # HGNC symbols
colnames(counts) <- barcodes

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Standard workflow
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Find markers for all clusters
markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

top10 <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))

# Load data
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(matrix) <- genes$V2  # HGNC symbols
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, project = "PBMC")

# Seurat pipeline
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Differential expression between cluster 0 and 3
markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, logfc.threshold = 0)

# Volcano plot
markers <- markers %>% 
  mutate(gene = rownames(markers),
         log2FC = avg_log2FC,
         p_adj = p_val_adj,
         neg_log10_padj = -log10(p_adj),
         significant = abs(log2FC) > 1 & p_adj < 0.05)

ggplot(markers, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value",
       color = "Significant") +
  theme_minimal()

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)

# Set file paths (adjust if needed)
barcode_file <- "barcodes.tsv"
gene_file    <- "genes.tsv"
matrix_file  <- "matrix.mtx"

# Read the sparse matrix
counts <- readMM(matrix_file)

# Read barcodes and genes
barcodes <- read.delim(barcode_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes   <- read.delim(gene_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                      col.names = c("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))

# Assign row and column names
rownames(counts) <- genes$gene_id
colnames(counts) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add gene symbols as metadata
pbmc[["gene_symbols"]] <- genes$gene_symbol[match(rownames(pbmc), genes$gene_id)]

# Calculate percent mitochondrial genes
# Assuming mitochondrial genes start with "MT-"
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells: remove low-quality cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Perform PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Save the final Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_final.rds")

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# 1. Load PBMC data (assuming 10X Genomics format)
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "path/to/10x/data")
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# 2. Add metadata: percent mitochondrial genes
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# 3. QC filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# 4. Normalization
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# 5. Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# 6. Scaling
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# 7. PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# 8. Determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc)

# 9. UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# 10. Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# 11. Visualize clusters
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()

# 12. Identify cluster markers
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# 13. Save markers
write.csv(pbmc.markers, file = "PBMC_cluster_markers.csv")

# 14. Annotate clusters using known markers
cluster.ids <- c("CD4 T", "CD8 T", "NK", "B", "Monocytes", "Dendritic", "Megakaryocytes")
names(cluster.ids) <- levels(pbmc)
pbmc <- RenameIdents(pbmc, cluster.ids)

# 15. Visualize annotated clusters
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()

# 16. Save Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "PBMC_seurat_object.rds")

pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("UMAP of PBMC clusters")

cluster2 <- 1

# Subset cells belonging to the two clusters
cells_to_compare <- WhichCells(pbmc, idents = c(cluster1, cluster2))
pbmc_subset <- subset(pbmc, cells = cells_to_compare)

# Perform differential expression analysis
de_markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc_subset, ident.1 = cluster1, ident.2 = cluster2, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

de_markers$gene <- rownames(de_markers)

  mutate(log10pval = -log10(p_val_adj),
         significance = case_when(
           p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0 ~ "Up in cluster1",
           p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < 0 ~ "Up in cluster2",
           TRUE ~ "Not significant"
         ))

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in cluster1" = "red", "Up in cluster2" = "blue", "Not significant" = "grey")) +

dir.create(markers_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
